text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparations for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) are complete.
The fulfilling summer training camp had reached its final day in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this is the stuff!
It's an annual tradition, but having a barbecue
on the last day really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"All the tiredness just blows right away!
Mmm~, so sweet!★"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Vivlos, you're already on dessert?
I know you're a light eater, but isn't that
a bit too little, even for you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nope, I'm gonna eat some more
grilled carrots after thisâª
The ice cream is, like, an intermission dessert?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, like a palate cleanser in the middle of a full-course meal♪
Aha, feels so classy~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I-Is that so?
...Wait, two ice creams?
Wasn't the rule one per person?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. 'Cause Cheval-chi said she'd give it to me~♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Cheval did?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, where did that girl—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are! Cheval—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Chevaaall?
Cheval Grand-chaaan.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A-Ah... C-Crown-san!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm s-so... You had to see me at my worst...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm fine!
It's not like I was drooling in my sleep or anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: D-Drool... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I saw quite a rare sight just now.
You, nodding off while ignoring food completely."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you... um...
saying that I'm normally a big eater...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm saying it's wonderful to have a big appetite!
We're athletes, so it's only natural, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's not what I mean.
...Looks like you pushed yourself pretty hard this summer, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It looks like they've added quite a few new items to the menu, too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! Y-You know—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I know. I've told you before, haven't I?
I always keep track of my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: May I look forward to it, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: A declaration of war... from you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
――... Ahaha!
In that case, you definitely gotta eat instead of sleep!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Look, it seems they've finished baking over there.
Let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, w-wait...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the summer night wore on.
The days leading up to the decisive autumn
were about to begin once more.
